decisions.reason: The firm remains committed to this close-to-core module and its public mention, treating continued weak results as temporary rather than reversing its earlier commitment.
The dedicated page and strong central fit create strong escalation pressure, making dropping very unlikely despite ongoing modest performance.
As a close-to-established relay module with existing investment and website presence, management continues to justify the launch and attribute disappointing sales to temporary factors.
Although less central than core modules, prior investment and public visibility still tilt toward persistence, though the drop risk is somewhat higher.
Since this module builds on the established platform and was only launched in 2024, early weak results are likely seen as temporary and insufficient to reverse public commitment.
The remote access service supports the announced charging and energy-management direction, and its website mention reflects enough commitment to continue despite early uncertainty.
